description: This PHP class defines a console command 'instance:create-db-savepoint' used to create a database savepoint with a specified name within the OrangeHRM testing framework. It interacts with the DatabaseBackupService to perform the savepoint creation and outputs success message upon completion.

classes.name: CreateDatabaseSavepointCommand
classes.description: A console command class to create database savepoints with user-specified names for testing purposes.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command string identifier for this console command.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command description and arguments for the console command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the creation of the database savepoint and outputs success message.
